title: Chapter 1367
text:
In the vast starry sky, a golden spark suddenly flashed and quickly expanded into a golden vortex, spitting out Han Xiao. Then, the Sanctum passage disappeared on its own.

Han Xiao quickly came back to his senses.

"Although it's only my second time experiencing it, this feeling is quite amazing …"

Han Xiao muttered and adjusted his thoughts with ease. He looked down and saw that the Sanctum mark had disappeared, and the interface could be opened again. A notification popped up that he had entered the First Sanctum.

Every time he entered a different Sanctum, his authority would increase. He had calculated when he entered, which was why his authority in the First Sanctum had reached level 8.

After sorting out his thoughts, Han Xiao stored the technical information of the First Sanctum in his memory palace. He then took out his communicator and looked at it. His eyes lit up.

"The last time I entered the Third Sanctum, it was more than three months. This time, it's only been about two months. The higher the authority, the more the flow of time will converge. In such a short time, there shouldn't be any problems with the war … right?"

Han Xiaoxin immediately dialed Simon's number. After two rings, the call was picked up.

Simon's figure appeared on the screen with a look of surprise in his eyes.

"Your Excellency Black Star, you're finally back!"

Hmm? This hopeful tone sounded like the reaction of someone who had met their savior when they were in a predicament … Could it be that something bad had happened?

Could it be that I have to turn the tide? It can't be so coincidental, right?

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat, and a bunch of thoughts flashed through his mind. He asked tentatively, "I've only disappeared for about two months. Did something happen on your side?"

"Although there are some changes, we can still handle it." Through the screen, Simon did not feel Han Xiao's mentality. He smiled and said, "Now that you're back, we're even more confident."

After hearing Simon's explanation, Han Xiao knew that he had misunderstood.

His teammates were still quite strong, and the impact of missing him for a few months was not big. He was mainly relieved that he had found his backbone and could finally continue to rely on him.

… That's right, with the foundation from before, the three Universal Civilizations would not be so weak. I'm thinking too much.

After hearing about the current situation, Han Xiao rubbed his chin and pondered.

"That's why the World Tree has built a super-visual-range barracks and is shooting at us. The construction of the interception circle and the space anchor orbit is facing huge resistance … If we want to destroy the other party's strategy, we have to start with positioning, right?"

"That's the situation, but we're currently in a passive position. We can only reverse lock when the enemy fires, and other conventional detection methods are basically blocked …" Simon explained.

"Hmm … The World Tree chose to build a camp at a further jump point, away from our coverage area. It's indeed not easy …"

"You can't do anything either?" Although Simon didn't have much hope, seeing that the always confident Black Star didn't seem to have a clue, he couldn't help but feel discouraged.

Because Han Xiao had always been very reliable, he had already established a 'know-it-all' halo in the hearts of the three Universal Civilizations' officers. If they encountered a problem that they could not solve, although they would not react rationally, they would more or less feel a little frustrated emotionally, which was human nature.

"I'm not sure yet. Let me go and take a look at the situation."

Han Xiao did not give a definite answer.

Regarding the situation that Simon had mentioned, his brain was working rapidly, screening one plan after another, and looking for any technology that could be used in this regard … Needless to say, in the information brought out from the First Sanctum this time, there was indeed a special detection technology suitable for this situation. It came from an advanced civilization of another Iteration, and it was specially used for over-the-horizon battles where the enemy's coordinates were unknown.

According to the data, the strength of this civilization was their over-the-horizon combat. Without the use of fast wormholes and stargates, they could even cross several star fields to launch precise over-the-horizon attacks on moving targets. Their range was extremely wide, and they were very sharp.

There were countless mechanical technologies stored in the First Sanctum. He had only dug out a small portion of them this time, but it was already an extremely huge technological treasure. It was not that he liked the new and disliked the old, but in terms of comprehensiveness, he was indeed miles ahead of Jayz's treasure.

The experience and accumulation of multiple Iterations allowed them to deal with all kinds of situations, and they had targeted solutions to many tactical strategies. This was an advantage that Jayz's treasure could not provide.

Originally, the World Tree Civilization had devoured the accumulation of multiple civilizations, so they had a certain advantage on the battlefield. This wave of information was enough to fill the gap between the two sides and even gain an advantage.

To the current three Universal Civilizations, this wave of technical information was like coal in the snow, a priceless treasure!

This way, even if the World Tree's revival mechanism and resource conversion were almost unsolvable, the three Universal Civilizations would be able to last longer and buy more time for the secondary dimension expedition team.

"With this batch of technical information, our chances of fighting against the World Tree Civilization will be greater … It's a pity that none of the Iterations have encountered an opponent like the World Tree. Otherwise, it would have been great to have a targeted device."

Han Xiao was secretly overjoyed, but at the same time, he felt a little regretful.

After this trip to the Sanctums, he had made a new discovery. The information stored in each Sanctum was different. The First Sanctum was mainly mechanical, but he did not find Information Form technology.

If the five Super classes each corresponded to a Sanctum, he guessed that the extra Sixth Sanctum might be storing information related to Information Form technology. This was the best weapon to counter the World Tree.

However, the key to the Sixth Sanctum was too difficult to synthesize, and it was not on the same level as the other five Sanctums. Han Xiao had never even heard of some of the materials.

Just as he was thinking, Simon spoke again with a curious tone.

"Did your Sanctum Revival succeed?"

"Hmm, there's still one last step. I need to gather the other Beyond Grade As to hold the fort to prevent any trouble."

Han Xiao nodded and replied. He could not help but think of the World Tree's revival.

According to his experience in his previous life, most of the World Tree experts' resurrection speed ranged from two to eight months. They were divided into different intervals according to their strength level. The resurrection time of a peak Beyond Grade A usually fluctuated randomly between five to eight months, and it was different every time. The resurrection time of a Tree King was not within this standard.

"That's good. Come to the main base. I'll gather everyone and wait for you." Simon was overjoyed.

"Hmm, I'll go later."

Han Xiao hung up the communication and dialed Oathkeeper's number.

This time, it rang for a full thirty seconds before the call was reluctantly picked up.

"You're back." Oathkeeper appeared on the screen expressionlessly.

"… Why don't you look happy at all?"

"I'm very happy."

This sentence, coupled with your dead fish face and sharp tone, is not convincing at all!

Han Xiaoxin cursed in his heart and said helplessly, "Alright, I'm fine.

I'm just informing you that I'm back. There are many direct descendants of civilizations among the targets of the revival this time, so I can't send them to the Holy Covenant. "

"Oh."

"… If you have nothing else to say, I'll hang up."

The corner of Han Xiao's mouth twitched. He ended the communication, changed into the King, and disappeared.

On the other side, in the Holy Covenant base.

Oathkeeper, who was sitting in front of the card table, put down the communicator. He turned his head and saw the members of the Holy Covenant organization in the activity room staring at him with burning eyes.

"Black Star is back?!"

"Finally, another group of people is going to be revived. There might be my enemies among them."

"Hahahaha, these people can't join the Holy Covenant. If they participate in the battle, does that mean we don't have to come out?"

"Let those direct descendants die on the battlefield, and our revenge will be indirectly avenged. Black Star is amazing!"

In the room, many of the revivors reacted intensely. They threw down the cards in their hands, and the atmosphere was elated.

Seeing this, Oathkeeper's hand tightened slightly, and his heart was filled with jealousy.

The boss's experience card had expired again …

…

In the combat conference room of the interceptor circle's main base, everyone gathered around the throne. A light flashed, and Han Xiao, who was wearing the King, teleported over.

"The president is back!" "Army Commander!" "Your Excellency Black Star!"

As soon as they saw Han Xiao, everyone greeted him.

"Thank you for your hard work while I was away."

Han Xiao put away the King and waved his hands with a smile. This was the style of a leader, and everyone present was used to it.

"When will we complete the Sanctum Revival?" Simon walked up and asked.

Hearing this, most of the Beyond Grade As also looked at Han Xiao curiously. Most of them only knew about the existence of the Sanctum Revival, but they had never seen how it was carried out. They were very interested.

"There's no rush. Let me take a look at the current situation first."

Han Xiao shook his head and went straight to the command platform. He pulled up the overall surveillance and the battle reports of the past few days and quickly browsed through them.

Seeing this, no one rushed him and followed behind him, not disturbing Han Xiao from observing the situation.

However, this scene gave many people a strange feeling. For some reason, they felt like their work was being reviewed by their leader.

After looking at it for a while, Han Xiao looked away and said to Simon, "I understand the situation now.

"I'm already clear about the situation. I have a way that might be able to counter the World Tree's strategy."

"You really have a way?"

Simon was stunned.

Just now, you said that you weren't confident, but now that you've seen the specific situation, you've already thought of a countermeasure. So quickly?

"I have a special detection technology that might be able to solve the problem of positioning …" Han Xiao derived the technical information from his memories, hid the technical details, and gave the general principle and effect to the group.

Simon quickly finished reading the information, and his expression became more and more surprised.

"If this technology is real, not only can it break the current tug-of-war, but it can also change the direction of our future decisions. This can bring more new tactics and expand our tactical combination library!"

The Beyond Grade As also took a look at the introduction of the technology. The Mechanics were shocked and could not help but size up Han Xiao in surprise.

Compared to the others, the experts were even more shocked. One look and they could tell that as long as they followed the blueprint, it would definitely be a Universal Treasure-level device. Just this technology alone was enough to change the way an advanced civilization fought!

Not only did Black Star's combat strength improve rapidly, but even his research had reached this level? When did he develop such a strategic observation technique?!

Han Xiao looked around and nodded.

"Of course it's real. I can share a portion of the technology and let the military factories of the three Universal Civilizations build the framework. I'll be in charge of the core, dividing the work, and increasing efficiency."

He did not plan to hide a portion of the technology that would be helpful to the battle. He only controlled the core technology, and the three Universal Civilizations would provide the resources to build the other aspects, increasing the capital of the three Universal Civilizations to fight against the World Tree.

"Good! As expected of the special consultant. I'll ask the three leaders later! "

Simon immediately perked up.

Black Star had just returned, and he had already proposed a solution to the problem that had troubled them for two months. Not only was he unique in terms of intelligence, but he also had some achievements in terms of strategic technology … Black Star was indeed as reliable as ever!

Looking at everyone's surprised expressions, Han Xiao was calm and did not take credit for it.

Strictly speaking, this was not his own ability, but the strength of the advanced civilizations of the various iterations. He was only standing on the shoulders of the giants and grasping the information gap. He had nothing to be proud of.

Putting away his thoughts, Han Xiao waved his hand and said with a solemn tone, "Let's put this aside for now.

Choose a place for me to use the Sanctum Revival. This time, it's different from before. If we ask this batch of revivors to participate in the battle, there will definitely be many people who won't accept it. I don't want any accidents. All Beyond Grade As, follow me! "

"Okay!"

Everyone's expression turned serious as they agreed.
